statement: For an induced m-vertex subgraph H of a (99,14,1,2) graph, if K=H+4I is positive definite, every occurring exterior type t has t^T K^-1 t<=4; any two distinct exterior vertices with types t,u and adjacency a satisfy (a-t^T K^-1 u)^2<=(4-t^T K^-1 t)(4-u^T K^-1 u). The whole Schur complement is positive semidefinite of rank55-m.

scope.population: Every hypothetical finite simple order99 regular degree14 graph with adjacent CN1/nonadjacent CN2; its complete induced m-vertex H with H+4I positive definite, and actual exterior binary neighborhood columns.

assumptions: Finite simple (99,14,1,2) graph with its complete real adjacency
H is the complete induced m-vertex adjacency, not a selected subgraph omitting edges
K=H+4I is positive definite; singular K is outside this statement
A pair denotes two distinct exterior vertices, including two vertices with the same type
a is their actual binary adjacency
